# PERIOCULAR INFECTIONS

## Eyelid infections

Patients with moderate or severe eyelid infections should be referred to ophthalmology.

## Blepharitis

Wash margins with baby shampoo daily and use warm compresses daily. Antimicrobials have no benefit.

## Hordeolum (stye)

For external disease (involving the gland of Zeis), daily hot pack massage encourages drainage and relieves symptoms. For internal disease (involving Meibomian glands) ophthalmology consult is encouraged, as the infection seldom drains without intervention.

## Lacrimal infections

Refer cases of lacrimal infection to ophthalmology, including infections of the lacrimal gland (dacryoadenitis), lacrimal sac (dacrocystitis), or tear ducts (canaliculitis).
